text.Borç Kapatma Kredisi: Kart Borçlarını Te: Debt Consolidation Loans: Does It Make Sense to Combine Card Debt Into One Installment? - KredimGeldi
text.Kredi kartı ve kredili mevduat hesabı bo: When does it pay to close credit card and overdraft account debt with a personal loan? How to calculate it, the risks and what to watch out for.
text.Birden fazla kredi kartı ve kredili mevd: Managing debt on several credit cards and overdraft accounts (KMH) can be both exhausting and expensive. Different minimum payments on different dates every month, interest charged statement after statement, and the risk of falling behind... A debt consolidation loan aims to pay off these debts with a single personal loan and turn them into one payment with a fixed installment.
text.Borç kapatma kredisi nedir?: What is a debt consolidation loan?
text.Borç kapatma kredisi, mevcut kart ve hes: A debt consolidation loan is a personal loan you take out to pay off your existing card and account debts. Some banks offer it as a separate product and transfer the loan amount directly to your debts at other banks. You can also take out a standard personal loan from your own bank and pay off your debts yourself.
text.Karar vermeden önce nasıl hesaplanır?: How to calculate it before deciding
text.Doğru karar için iki senaryoyu aynı süre: To make the right decision, compare two scenarios over the same period:
text.Bu tutarı, aynı borcu kartta 24 ayda öde: Compare this amount with the total cost of paying off the same debt on your card over 24 months. The processing fee is at most 300 TL (0.5%).
text.Borç kapatma kredisi ancak kartlar yenid: A debt consolidation loan only works if you don't run your cards up again. If you keep spending once your limits are freed up, you'll be facing both the loan installment and new card debt.
text.Tüm borçlarınızı tutar, faiz ve son ödem: List all your debts with their amount, interest rate and payment due date.
text.Teklifleri karşılaştırıp size en uygun k: Compare offers and choose the loan that suits you best.
text.Kredi hesabınıza geçer geçmez en yüksek: As soon as the loan reaches your account, pay off your debts, starting with the most expensive one.
text.İhtiyacınız olmayan kart limitlerini düş: Consider lowering card limits you don't need or closing extra cards.
text.Taksiti maaş hesabınızdan otomatik ödeme: Set up automatic payment of the installment from your salary account.
text.Borcunuz kadar tutarı ve uygun vadeyi gi: Enter an amount equal to your debt and a suitable term, and compare banks' personal loan offers.
text.Borç kapatma kredisi kredi notumu düşürü: Will a debt consolidation loan lower my credit score?
text.Yeni bir kredi başvurusu kısa vadede sın: A new loan application may have a limited effect in the short term, but freed-up card limits and regular installment payments will have a positive effect on your score over time.
text.Kart borcumu başka bankadan aldığım kred: Can I pay off my card debt with a loan from another bank?
text.Evet. Kredi hangi bankadan alınırsa alın: Yes. Whichever bank the loan comes from, you can use the amount to pay off your card and account debts at other banks. Some banks make this transfer themselves.
text.Asgari ödeme yapmak yerine kredi çekmek: Does it make sense to take out a loan instead of making minimum payments?
text.Sürekli asgari ödeme yapıyorsanız borcun: If you keep making only the minimum payment, most of the debt goes to interest. If the total cost of the loan is lower, a debt consolidation loan is the better option.

html.<strong>Daha düşük maliyet:</strong> Kre: Lower cost: Credit card and overdraft (KMH) interest rates are generally higher than personal loan rates. Moving the debt to a lower-cost loan can reduce the total interest you pay.
html.<strong>Sabit taksit:</strong> İhtiyaç k: Fixed installment: With a personal loan, the installment amount and term are set from the start. You know exactly when your debt will be paid off.
html.<strong>Tek ödeme günü:</strong> Birden: One payment date: Tracking a single installment instead of multiple due dates reduces the risk of late payments.
html.<strong>Kredi notuna olumlu etki:</stron: Positive effect on your credit score: Freeing up your card limits lowers your credit utilization ratio. Paying installments regularly also supports your score.
html.<strong>Mevcut durum:</strong> Kart ve K: Current situation: Write down the total of your card and overdraft debts, the monthly interest rates applied and how many months it would take you to pay them off. Your bank's mobile app shows the current interest rate and statement details for each card.
html.<strong>Kredi senaryosu:</strong> Aynı t: Loan scenario: For the same amount, calculate personal loan offers based on total repayment, including KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund), BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax) and the processing fee.
html.<strong>Karşılaştırın:</strong> Kredi se: Compare: If the loan scenario's total repayment is lower and the monthly installment fits your budget, consolidating your debt makes sense.
Don't choose a longer term than you need. A long term lowers the installment but increases the total interest; your savings can disappear.
html.<strong>Tutar ve vade sınırlarını kontro: Check the amount and term limits. The term available on personal loans is limited according to the loan amount.
html.<strong>Gecikmedeki borçlar onayı zorlaş: Overdue debts can make approval harder. If you have a debt under legal collection, getting loan approval becomes more difficult; talk to your bank about restructuring options first.
